_notes.widths: Capture widths in CSS pixels. 1440 = desktop, 390 = iPhone-class mobile.
_notes.maxLayoutShiftPx: Budget from the redesign acceptance criterion: nothing may move more than this on a page that is not expected to change.
_notes.maxChangedPct: Percentage of the page that may look different before it is treated as a regression. Cosmetic anti-aliasing noise sits well under 0.5%.
_notes.expectedToChange: Routes the spec explicitly says will change, e.g. "/about/" or "/". Listed routes are still measured and reported, but do not fail the run. Use the exact route as printed in the report.
_notes.expectedToChangeShape: Either a plain route string, or { "route": "/about/", "reason": "new hero type scale" }.
